brief:
France condemned statements by Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir in which he called on the Israeli military to carry out killing operations in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The French government said the remarks breached accepted humanitarian standards and crossed every line of acceptable conduct.

A statement from Paris characterized Ben Gvir's comments as inhumane and rejected them outright. The condemnation reflected France's position that such rhetoric violates international norms governing military conduct and the treatment of civilians in armed conflict.
